verdict.rationale: Docs confirm serverless endpoints host 100+ open-source models with per-token pricing, no provisioning latency, and OpenAI-compatible API for easy integration, matching the story's core claim of a broad open-weight catalog on shared serverless infra. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming specific families like Llama/Qwen/DeepSeek/GPT-OSS in the catalog, and independent third-party verification of catalog breadth beyond vendor docs and mixed community pricing/performance comments.
